title: Choose ASM's trading identity
question: Same Quotex layout, new identity. The roll assigned the Exchange Split-Flap Board. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Exchange Split-Flap Board
options.lineage: Solari quotation boards on trading floors and station concourses
options.thesis: Every number that matters — price, balance, countdown, payout — is a flap that clacks over when it changes; trades and deposits read like departures with an honest status.
materials: matte flap tiles with a centre hinge line
options.viewport: Icon rail and top bar in board-black; the balance flaps top-right under a solid yellow LIVE plate (DEMO is a hatched plate); chart centre on a faint board grid; right ticket shows expiry as a live 00:01:27 flap countdown above two full-width UP ▲ / DOWN ▼ slabs; open trades listed as a departures board with status flaps.
options.risk: Flap motion on every tick becomes noise if it isn't reserved for values the trader watches; it can drift toward a railway costume if the flaps leak into buttons and chrome.

raised.raise: Rank by inversion: exactly one solid knocked-out plate per screen — UP/DOWN on Trade, Deposit on money screens — everything else stays outlined.
State is never hue alone: ▲/▼ glyphs, +/− signs and status words carry up/down, won/lost and approved/rejected for colour-blind traders.
Money flows (deposit, checkout, withdrawal) run as numbered steps 01·02·03 in a strict margin column, so the trader always knows where they are in the wait.
One error form only: an inserted red status slip in the row where the problem is, never toasts or scattered red text.
Only one thing is lit at a time: the active account plate and the live price carry the single warm glow; nothing else glows.

options.label: Dalal Street Ticker Wall
options.lineage: The BSE building's LED ticker façade and exchange scroll boards
options.thesis: The platform is the ticker wall on Dalal Street: dot-matrix LED numerals on true black, amber for the brand, green and red for the tape.
options.viewport: A thin scrolling asset tape under the top bar; balance and price in dot-matrix amber; chart on pure black; UP/DOWN as lit green and red LED slabs.
options.risk: The most familiar trading look — close to what many brokers already ship; dot-matrix numerals lose legibility at small sizes and red/green LED everywhere gets loud.

options.label: Signal Bench Oscilloscope
options.lineage: CRT oscilloscopes on a lab bench
options.thesis: The chart is a phosphor trace on an etched graticule; duration and stake are detented knobs; readouts are seven-segment.
options.viewport: Chart fills a square-gridded glass; ticket as a knob strip with amber seven-segment time and stake; trades as channel readouts.
options.case: Fuses cleanly on clarity — a price chart already is a trace on a grid, and detented knobs map to duration/stake — but traders don't identify with lab gear, and phosphor green collides with UP green.
options.risk: Reads as an engineering tool, not a trading brand; green-on-black dilutes up/down meaning.

options.label: Normalled Jackfield
options.thesis: Amber link lines on black glass whose stroke pattern, not colour, carries state.
options.viewport: Numbered lanes with a link rail per row.
options.case: Single-amber palette can't carry up/down, and traders don't recognise patch bays.
options.kept: Rank by inversion — one solid plate per screen.

options.label: Tensegrity Column
options.thesis: Forces made visible; slack, balanced, stressed and failed are distinct shapes.
options.viewport: A force diagram instead of a page.
options.case: Pale concrete ground and sculptural layout break the binding broker layout.

options.label: Orizuru Fold Sequence
options.viewport: A folding diagram with a numbered margin column.
options.case: No trading resonance; vermilion ground fights red DOWN.
options.kept: Numbered steps in a strict margin column for money flows.

options.label: Acetate Tab Manual
options.thesis: Punched acetate leaves over coloured divider boards.
options.case: Light paper world and serif reading measure suit docs, not a chart screen open for hours.
options.kept: One error form: a red errata slip in place.

options.label: Console Void Menu
options.thesis: Objects floating in a particle-lit void.
options.case: Depth and drift destroy density and numeric scanability.
options.kept: Only the selected thing is lit.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A Quotex / IQ Option / Olymp Trade peer played straight: navy panels, blue brand, green Up and red Down, at full craft.
canonCard.viewport: Exactly the reference screens, rebuilt cleanly with a proper component kit.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from the broker it copies — the opposite of 'own identity'.
